title_en: If I had … / If we went … etc.
title_vi: If I had … / If we went … v.v. (câu điều kiện giả định hiện tại)
theory_html:
A. If he had the money …

A. Nếu anh ấy có tiền …

Dan likes fast cars, but he doesn’t have one. He doesn’t have enough money.

Dan thích xe hơi tốc độ cao, nhưng anh ấy không có chiếc nào. Anh ấy không đủ tiền.

  • If he had the money, he would buy a fast car.

    Nếu anh ấy có tiền, anh ấy sẽ mua một chiếc xe tốc độ cao.

Usually had is past, but in this sentence had is not past. If he had the money = if he had the money now (but he doesn’t have it).

Thường had là quá khứ, nhưng trong câu này had không phải quá khứ. If he had the money = nếu bây giờ anh ấy có tiền (nhưng anh ấy không có).

if ……
If + had / knew / lived (etc.) … ,would … / wouldn’t …
If + didn’t have / didn’t know (etc.) … ,could … / couldn’t …
If + were … / could … ,would … / could …

You can say: If he had the money, he would buy a car. or He would buy a car if he had the money.

Có thể nói: If he had the money, he would buy a car. hoặc He would buy a car if he had the money.

B. I’d / she’d / they’d = I would / she would / they would

  • I don’t know the answer. If I knew the answer, I’d tell you.

    Tôi không biết câu trả lời. Nếu tôi biết, tôi sẽ nói bạn.

  • It’s raining, so we’re not going out. We’d get wet if we went out.

    Trời đang mưa nên chúng tôi không ra ngoài. Chúng tôi sẽ bị ướt nếu ra ngoài.

  • Jane lives in a city. She likes cities. She wouldn’t be happy if she lived in the country.

    Jane sống ở thành phố. Cô ấy thích thành phố. Cô ấy sẽ không vui nếu sống ở nông thôn.

  • If you didn’t have a job, what would you do? (but you have a job)

    Nếu bạn không có việc làm, bạn sẽ làm gì? (nhưng bạn có việc)

  • I’m sorry I can’t help you. I’d help you if I could. (but I can’t)

    Xin lỗi tôi không giúp được bạn. Tôi sẽ giúp nếu tôi có thể. (nhưng tôi không thể)

  • If we had a car, we could travel more. (but we don’t have a car, so we can’t travel much)

    Nếu chúng tôi có xe, chúng tôi có thể đi nhiều hơn. (nhưng không có xe nên không đi được nhiều)

C. If (I) was/were …

You can say: if I/he/she/it was or if I/he/she/it were.

Có thể nói: if I/he/she/it was hoặc if I/he/she/it were.

  • It’s not a very nice place. I wouldn’t go there if I were you. (or … if I was you)

    Chỗ đó không đẹp lắm. Nếu tôi là bạn, tôi sẽ không đến đó. (hoặc … if I was you)

  • It would be nice if the weather was better. (or … if the weather were better)

    Sẽ thật tuyệt nếu thời tiết đẹp hơn. (hoặc … if the weather were better)

  • What would Tom do if he were here? (or … if he was here)

    Tom sẽ làm gì nếu anh ấy ở đây? (hoặc … if he was here)

D. Compare: if I have / if it is … and if I had / if it was …

D. So sánh: if I have / if it is … và if I had / if it was …

if I have / if it is etc.
if I have / if it is v.v.		if I had / if it was etc.
if I had / if it was v.v.
I must go and see Helen. If I have time, I will go today. (= maybe I’ll have time, so maybe I’ll go)
Tôi phải đi thăm Helen. Nếu có thời gian, hôm nay tôi sẽ đi. (= có thể tôi có thời gian, nên có thể tôi đi)		I must go and see Helen. If I had time, I would go today. (= I don’t have time today, so I will not go)
Tôi phải đi thăm Helen. Nếu tôi có thời gian, hôm nay tôi sẽ đi. (= hôm nay tôi không có thời gian, nên không đi)
I like that jacket. I’ll buy it if it isn’t too expensive. (= maybe it will not be too expensive)
Tôi thích cái áo khoác đó. Tôi sẽ mua nếu nó không quá đắt. (= có thể nó không quá đắt)		I like this jacket, but it’s very expensive. I’d buy it if it wasn’t so expensive. (= it is expensive, so I’m not going to buy it)
Tôi thích cái áo này, nhưng nó rất đắt. Tôi sẽ mua nếu nó không đắt thế. (= nó đắt, nên tôi sẽ không mua)
I’ll help you if I can. (= maybe I can)
Tôi sẽ giúp bạn nếu có thể. (= có thể tôi giúp được)		I’d help you if I could, but I can’t.
Tôi sẽ giúp bạn nếu tôi có thể, nhưng tôi không thể.

mcq.question: If he ___ the money, he would buy a fast car.
mcq.full: If he had the money, he would buy a fast car.
mcq.vi: Nếu anh ấy có tiền, anh ấy sẽ mua một chiếc xe tốc độ cao.
mcq.expl:
If + past (had / knew / lived / didn’t have) … would / could … = an unreal situation now; had is not past here.
If + quá khứ (had / knew / lived / didn’t have) … would / could … = tình huống không có thật ở hiện tại; had ở đây không mang nghĩa quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không có thật → if + quá khứ.
mcq.key: If he ___ the money, he would buy a fast car.|had

mcq.question: Jane likes cities. She ___ happy if she lived in the country.
mcq.full: Jane likes cities. She wouldn’t be happy if she lived in the country.
mcq.vi: Jane thích thành phố. Cô ấy sẽ không vui nếu sống ở nông thôn.
mcq.expl:
I’d / she’d / they’d = I would / she would / they would; could = would be able to.
I’d / she’d / they’d = I would / she would / they would; could = sẽ có thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: wouldn’t.
mcq.key: Jane likes cities. She ___ happy if she lived in the country.|wouldn’t be

mcq.question: If you ___ a job, what would you do?
mcq.full: If you didn’t have a job, what would you do?
mcq.vi: Nếu bạn không có việc làm, bạn sẽ làm gì?
mcq.expl:
I’d / she’d / they’d = I would / she would / they would; could = would be able to.
I’d / she’d / they’d = I would / she would / they would; could = sẽ có thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + didn’t have.
mcq.key: If you ___ a job, what would you do?|didn’t have

mcq.question: I’m sorry I can’t help you. I’d help you if I ___.
mcq.full: I’m sorry I can’t help you. I’d help you if I could.
mcq.vi: Xin lỗi tôi không giúp được bạn. Tôi sẽ giúp nếu tôi có thể.
mcq.expl:
I’d / she’d / they’d = I would / she would / they would; could = would be able to.
I’d / she’d / they’d = I would / she would / they would; could = sẽ có thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: if I could (nhưng tôi không thể).
mcq.key: I’m sorry I can’t help you. I’d help you if I ___.|could

mcq.question: If we had a car, we ___ travel more.
mcq.full: If we had a car, we could travel more.
mcq.vi: Nếu có xe, chúng tôi có thể đi nhiều hơn.
mcq.expl:
I’d / she’d / they’d = I would / she would / they would; could = would be able to.
I’d / she’d / they’d = I would / she would / they would; could = sẽ có thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: could.
mcq.key: If we had a car, we ___ travel more.|could

mcq.question: It’s not a very nice place. I wouldn’t go there if I ___ you.
mcq.full: It’s not a very nice place. I wouldn’t go there if I were you.
mcq.vi: Chỗ đó không đẹp lắm. Nếu tôi là bạn, tôi sẽ không đến đó.
mcq.expl:
if I/he/she/it was or were – both are possible (if I were you …).
if I/he/she/it was hoặc were – đều được (if I were you …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if I were you (hoặc was).
mcq.key: It’s not a very nice place. I wouldn’t go there if I ___ you.|were

mcq.question: It would be nice if the weather ___ better.
mcq.full: It would be nice if the weather was better.
mcq.vi: Sẽ thật tuyệt nếu thời tiết đẹp hơn.
mcq.expl:
if I/he/she/it was or were – both are possible (if I were you …).
if I/he/she/it was hoặc were – đều được (if I were you …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + was/were.
mcq.key: It would be nice if the weather ___ better.|was

mcq.question: What would Tom do if he ___ here?
mcq.full: What would Tom do if he were here?
mcq.vi: Tom sẽ làm gì nếu anh ấy ở đây?
mcq.expl:
if I/he/she/it was or were – both are possible (if I were you …).
if I/he/she/it was hoặc were – đều được (if I were you …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if he were/was.
mcq.key: What would Tom do if he ___ here?|were

mcq.question: I’m not hungry. I would have something to eat if I ___ hungry.
mcq.full: I’m not hungry. I would have something to eat if I were hungry.
mcq.vi: Tôi không đói. Tôi sẽ ăn chút gì nếu tôi đói.
mcq.expl:
if I/he/she/it was or were – both are possible (if I were you …).
if I/he/she/it was hoặc were – đều được (if I were you …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if I were/was.
mcq.key: I’m not hungry. I would have something to eat if I ___ hungry.|were

mcq.question: It’s not a very good hotel. ___ there if I were you.
mcq.full: It’s not a very good hotel. I wouldn’t stay there if I were you.
mcq.vi: Khách sạn đó không tốt lắm. Tôi sẽ không ở đó nếu tôi là bạn.
mcq.expl:
if I/he/she/it was or were – both are possible (if I were you …).
if I/he/she/it was hoặc were – đều được (if I were you …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: would not.
mcq.key: It’s not a very good hotel. ___ there if I were you.|I wouldn’t stay

mcq.question: It’s a shame you have to go now. ___ nice if you had more time.
mcq.full: It’s a shame you have to go now. It would be nice if you had more time.
mcq.vi: Tiếc là bạn phải đi rồi. Sẽ thật tuyệt nếu bạn có nhiều thời gian hơn.
mcq.expl:
if I/he/she/it was or were – both are possible (if I were you …).
if I/he/she/it was hoặc were – đều được (if I were you …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: would.
mcq.key: It’s a shame you have to go now. ___ nice if you had more time.|It would be

mcq.question: I’m not going to take the job. I’d take it if the salary ___ better.
mcq.full: I’m not going to take the job. I’d take it if the salary was better.
mcq.vi: Tôi sẽ không nhận việc đó. Tôi sẽ nhận nếu lương cao hơn.
mcq.expl:
if I/he/she/it was or were – both are possible (if I were you …).
if I/he/she/it was hoặc were – đều được (if I were you …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + was/were.
mcq.key: I’m not going to take the job. I’d take it if the salary ___ better.|was

mcq.question: I’d buy that jacket if it ___ a bit cheaper.
mcq.full: I’d buy that jacket if it was a bit cheaper.
mcq.vi: Tôi sẽ mua cái áo khoác đó nếu nó rẻ hơn một chút.
mcq.expl:
if I/he/she/it was or were – both are possible (if I were you …).
if I/he/she/it was hoặc were – đều được (if I were you …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + was/were.
mcq.key: I’d buy that jacket if it ___ a bit cheaper.|was

mcq.question: Life would be boring if every day ___ the same.
mcq.full: Life would be boring if every day was the same.
mcq.vi: Cuộc sống sẽ nhàm chán nếu ngày nào cũng giống nhau.
mcq.expl:
if I/he/she/it was or were – both are possible (if I were you …).
if I/he/she/it was hoặc were – đều được (if I were you …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + was/were.
mcq.key: Life would be boring if every day ___ the same.|was

mcq.question: I must go and see Helen. If I ___ time, I will go today.
mcq.full: I must go and see Helen. If I have time, I will go today.
mcq.vi: Tôi phải đi thăm Helen. Nếu có thời gian, hôm nay tôi sẽ đi.
mcq.expl:
if I have / if it is … will = possible; if I had / if it was … would = not real.
if I have / if it is … will = có thể xảy ra; if I had / if it was … would = không có thật.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Có thể xảy ra → if + hiện tại … will.
mcq.key: I must go and see Helen. If I ___ time, I will go today.|have

mcq.question: I must go and see Helen. If I had time, I ___ today.
mcq.full: I must go and see Helen. If I had time, I would go today.
mcq.vi: Tôi phải đi thăm Helen. Nếu có thời gian, hôm nay tôi sẽ đi. (nhưng tôi không có)
mcq.expl:
if I have / if it is … will = possible; if I had / if it was … would = not real.
if I have / if it is … will = có thể xảy ra; if I had / if it was … would = không có thật.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không có thật → would.
mcq.key: I must go and see Helen. If I had time, I ___ today.|would go

mcq.question: I like that jacket. I’ll buy it if it ___ too expensive.
mcq.full: I like that jacket. I’ll buy it if it isn’t too expensive.
mcq.vi: Tôi thích cái áo khoác đó. Tôi sẽ mua nếu nó không quá đắt.
mcq.expl:
if I have / if it is … will = possible; if I had / if it was … would = not real.
if I have / if it is … will = có thể xảy ra; if I had / if it was … would = không có thật.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Có thể xảy ra → if + hiện tại.
mcq.key: I like that jacket. I’ll buy it if it ___ too expensive.|isn’t

mcq.question: I like this jacket, but it’s very expensive. I’d buy it if it ___ so expensive.
mcq.full: I like this jacket, but it’s very expensive. I’d buy it if it wasn’t so expensive.
mcq.vi: Tôi thích cái áo này, nhưng nó rất đắt. Tôi sẽ mua nếu nó không đắt thế.
mcq.expl:
if I have / if it is … will = possible; if I had / if it was … would = not real.
if I have / if it is … will = có thể xảy ra; if I had / if it was … would = không có thật.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không có thật → if + quá khứ.
mcq.key: I like this jacket, but it’s very expensive. I’d buy it if it ___ so expensive.|wasn’t

mcq.question: I’ll help you if I ___.
mcq.full: I’ll help you if I can.
mcq.vi: Tôi sẽ giúp bạn nếu tôi có thể.
mcq.expl:
if I have / if it is … will = possible; if I had / if it was … would = not real.
if I have / if it is … will = có thể xảy ra; if I had / if it was … would = không có thật.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Có thể giúp → if I can … will.
mcq.key: I’ll help you if I ___.|can
